hero.title: Third Plane builds AI workforces for insurance.
hero.lead: Placement Desk takes on defined placement work across the systems and carrier channels your brokerage already uses.

problem.title: You can’t hire your way out of the bottleneck.
problem.body: Accounts are being worked more often, across more markets, with more follow-up. The placement workload keeps growing faster than the people available to handle it.

points.title: Markets go unshopped
points.body: Teams work the markets they have time to reach, even when there are more options available.

points.title: Quotes arrive late
points.body: Portal entry, follow-up and carrier back-and-forth slow down the path from submission to terms.

points.title: Renewals become reactive
points.body: Accounts get remarketed when someone has the capacity to work them, rather than when the business would benefit from it.

points.title: Growth gets constrained
points.body: Producers and account teams spend time working placement instead of pursuing new business and serving clients.

approach.title: Most AI gives your people another tool. Third Plane builds it into your organization.
approach.body: Give someone an AI tool and they still own the work. Third Plane assigns defined work to an AI workforce and returns the finished outcome to your people for review.

models.note: The employee operates the AI, reviews the output and still owns the work.
The business assigns the work to Placement Desk. The Desk executes it across your systems and carrier channels, then returns the result to your team.

desk.title: Send the work to the Placement Desk. Your team gets the quotes back.
desk.body: A dedicated placement function that takes new business and renewals from submission through returned quotes.

showcase.title: Two minutes on what changes when the work moves to a desk.
